# Folder Purpose: Handoff Queues

## Purpose

This folder stores generated role queue files for the AI Role Handoff System.

Each queue shows the Handoff Packets visible to a specific role.

## Generated Files

Generated by:

```bat
tools\aiworkflow\handoff_supervisor.bat write-docs --execute
```

Expected role queue files:

- `Planner.md`
- `Developer.md`
- `Artist.md`
- `Reviewer.md`
- `QA.md`

## Belongs Here

- Role-specific Handoff work queues
- Waiting user approval items visible to a role
- Ready work visible to a role
- In-progress role work
- Blocked role work

## Does Not Belong Here

- Source code
- Gameplay JSON
- Runtime artifacts
- Manual role routine documents
- Packet source documents
- Approval evidence
- Git operation logs

## Editing Rule

Queue files are generated surfaces.

Prefer regenerating them with the Handoff Supervisor instead of manually editing role queue rows.
